newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent gains ground on technical moves.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent gains ground on technical moves.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures gained ground on Wednesday after a choppy day's trading but dealers said there was little in the way of fundamental news moving prices.
November Brent was trading just below the day's highs at 1803 GMT and stood 10 cents up at $23.06 a barrel.
October gas oil closed at $225.00 a tonne, $1.75 up from Tuesday's close.
"There is nothing really new going on that we can see. It is mostly a technical picture at the moment," one dealer said, adding that she saw $23.35 as the next layer of resistance.
Dealers said U.S. heating oil prices were the main force driving the energy complex higher.
October heating oil was 2.21 cents a gallon up at 71.90 cents a gallon.
"It is really the U.S. strength on heating oil which is pushing Brent up," one said.

Oil prices fluctuated during the day as traders first interpreted weekly API distillate stock statistics as bullish, then sold off gasoline in response to the API data showing stocks over three million barrels up on last week.
